column1: # Ezhuthola's own extra Malayalam words (GPL-3.0, part of Ezhuthola).
# Common words the subtitle word list (FrequencyWords) is missing: places, festivals, everyday nouns.
# They give suffix splitting a real base: കേരളം -> കേരളത്തിൽ (keralathil).
# Format: word<TAB>count. The count is a modest made-up one, so real counts from the main list win.
# The app's own name, so it's spelled right from the first try (ezhuthola / ezhuththola)
# Food, apps and phone words people write in Malayalam (puttu, reels, insta).
